objective: LungVision AI — Phase 2B Readiness & Scientific Evidence Reconciliation: Resolve critical research discrepancies in model provenance, DRR physics, reconstruction evidence, multi-patient LUNA16 segmentation readiness, and scientific validation.
acceptance_criteria: 1. Model Provenance Reconciliation: Investigate DenseNet121 hash/parameter-count discrepancies, NIH macro AUROC differences, ResNet18 thresholds, and inference paths; author MODEL_PROVENANCE_RECONCILIATION.md.

2. DRR Physics Reconciliation: Inspect backend/app/services/drr_generator.py, scripts/3d_reconstruction/generate_drr.py, compare SOD 1000/SID 1400 vs SOD 1450/SDD 1800, check Siddon-Jacobs, coordinates, detector, HU conversion; author DRR_PHYSICS_RECONCILIATION.md.

3. Reconstruction Evidence Audit: Investigate SSM deformation, landmark detection, biplanar fusion endpoint, silhouette loss, differentiable renderer, PCT, E6 shortcut audit, Phase 2A results; distinguish 2D biplanar classification from 3D reconstruction; author RECONSTRUCTION_EVIDENCE_AUDIT.md.

4. Multi-Patient SSM Readiness: Investigate the reported 445 precomputed LUNA16 segmentation masks, scan IDs, mask-CT correspondence, physical geometry, label definitions, mesh extraction, missing scans, splits, and Kaggle notebook access; author SSM_MULTI_PATIENT_READINESS.md.

5. Scientific Validation & Go/No-Go Decision: Verify provenance of proposed SSM metrics/targets (PCA explained variance, correspondence, surface error, Dice, ASSD, HD95, landmark error); distinguish targets from achieved results; deliver authoritative Go/No-Go decision in PHASE_2B_GO_NO_GO.md.
non_goals: Do not download datasets, retrain models, modify checkpoints, or delete files
Do not repeat the full directory inventory
Do not overwrite historical research artifacts
Do not assume Kaggle paths are accessible from Windows host without evidence
